description: Every GGUF quantization published in the artifact repository of each of the 17 catalog models that have published model-offloading results, at the revision those runs measured.
size_basis: Hugging Face tree listing of each repository at the pinned revision: byte size and LFS SHA-256 of every file.
architecture_basis: Values llama.cpp printed when it loaded the measured artifact of the model in the published model-offloading runs: layers (n_layer), trained context (n_ctx_train), sliding window (n_swa) and parameter count (model params). The key and value elements per token are the bytes of key and value cache the engine allocated per context cell, summed over its caches and divided by two (f16 elements), so layers that keep no cache are not counted. They do not depend on the quantization.
excluded: Projector (mmproj), importance-matrix (imatrix) and mtp files, and split sets whose parts are ambiguous in the listing.
